simple.summary: כֶּחָשׁ (kechâsh) means faithless First listed occurrence: Isa 30 9.

definitions.full: H3586. kechash [ כֶּחָשׁ ] adjective deceptive, false (on formation see Ba NB 50 Ges § 84b ) — כֶּחָשִׁים בָּנִים Isa 30:9 (|| מְרִי עַם ).
